subject: Music Production
title: Fair Use and Transformative Sampling
description: A short lesson to help you apply Fair Use and Transformative Sampling.

hook.text: Fair use allows limited use of copyrighted material without permission for specific purposes.

buildup.text: Courts consider whether the new work transforms the original, giving it new meaning or expression.

discovery.text: A sample chopped, layered, and recontextualized beyond recognition may qualify as transformative use.

twist.text: Fair use decisions are unpredictable, and no formula guarantees a sample qualifies as transformative.

climax.text: The tension between fair use and copyright continues to shape how producers approach sampling today.

punchline.text: No formula can predict if a sample is fair use.

quiz.question: What does transformative use mean for sampling?
options: Using the sample without any changes
Changing the sample enough to give it new meaning or expression
